label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 42
title: MVP: add views for stores with no route/item (qa-weights, supervisor_state, ports, initial-context, BOM, design-spec, llm-errors, kit, adaptive_reasoning, generation-state, system_config, .agent.json)
body: Stores that have NO concrete API route and NO specifically-named dashboard item (BI-0015 covers them only generically). Tier 1 (high UI relevance): qa-weights.json (QIR weights), supervisor_state.json + supervision_cycles.jsonl (forge supervisor), ports.json (allocated dev ports), initial-context.json (intake->project context), BOM.json (SBOM), design-spec.json (design stage). Tier 2 (runtime internals / agent introspection): .agent.json (generated agent cards - dashboard currently reads .opencode/agent/*.md instead), llm-errors.json, kit.json, adaptive_reasoning.json, generation-state.json, system_config.json. Add read (and where safe, edit/reset) views for each.
